messages.subject: Multiple Table bind to one function
parts:
Hi,

hope this is not a redundant topic. My goal is to update multiple tables when the user clicks on a button. Here is some simple code:

  output$tableOne <- DT::renderDataTable({
    getData(foo)
  })
  
  getData <- reactive(function(funParameter){
    corrStartDate <- input$StartDate
    corrEndDate <- input$EndDate
    
    return(someData(corrBaseDim, corrBaseVal, funParameter))
  })

In all tables (if there is more then one) I wan't to show data with different base parameter (getData(foo)). So the second table could use "getData(bar)". I don't want to write every time the same function for another table.

The solution above is not working, since reactive functions do not support parameters.

How would you solve this?
